cases.title: bootc (qcow2 from Fedora CoreOS, Konflux-built container)
cases.footnote: An earlier run used quay.io/fedora/fedora-bootc:44 with a syft-generated input SBOM, because that image has no attached SBOM. It was replaced by this registry-attached Konflux SBOM. With the syft input the merged SBOM failed spdx-tools and mobster on undefined LicenseRefs from syft; with the Konflux SBOM both pass.
